name: hunk
title_zh: 改文件先拒绝再动手的事务型编辑器
tagline_zh: 别再用 python heredoc 读改写文件了。它把每次改动当事务：先检查所有替换点，有一个对不上就整体拒绝。
tagline_en: Stop writing read-replace-write heredocs. Treats each edit as a transaction: checks every match first, refuses.
desc_en: Edit files with `hunk`, a transactional multi-file editor whose refusals are the point. Use it instead of writing a Python or shell heredoc that reads a file, replaces text and writes it back - that shape, `python3 - <<'PY'` with a read/write pair, is what this tool exists to replace. Use it whenever an edit spans more than one replacement or more than one file, whenever an edit needs a build or t
why_zh: 核心不是替换文本，而是把「拒绝」当一等公民。跨文件多替换时，它先模拟全部改动，确认无歧义才落盘。
why_en: Refusal is the feature, not the fallback. It simulates every cross-file replacement before touching disk, killing the.
limit_zh: 只处理文本替换，不生成新文件、不跑构建、不处理二进制。需要你预先想清楚每个替换点的唯一匹配；模糊匹配时它宁可停下问你。
limit_en: Text replacement only—no file creation, builds, or binaries. Requires unambiguous match per edit point; on ambiguity it halts and asks, never guesses.
title_en: Transactional multi-file editor that refuses first
